title: Outside gym workout
author: Punakuu
desc:
Fullbody workout for outside gyms.

Example days:
Monday, wednesday, friday.

If you cannot do pull ups yet, start by hanging and doind slow negative reps.

If you cannot do dips yet, start by jumping up and do slow negative reps.

First movement is your main movement for that day.

If you want more dip focus instead of chest press, then change dips with chest press and chest press with dips.

If you want more pull-up focus, then you can replace lat pulldown with bodyweight pull-ups or chin-ups.

At the end of every workout, go for light jog. Try to keep your pulse around Zone 2 heart rate.
